basic_profile.bio: Avid fragrance enthusiast and amateur golfer based in Denton, Texas. I've been exploring the world of perfumes for over a decade, enjoying everything from niche fragrances to affordable clones. When I'm not testing out new scents, you can find me on the golf course or reading the latest yuri manga. I work as a freelance graphic designer, which gives me the flexibility to indulge in my varied hobbies. I'm single and enjoy the freedom to travel and explore different cultures through their scents. I tend to browse Reddit late at night after a busy day of work and leisure.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have gained a lot of my fragrance knowledge through personal exploration and communities like 'fragranceclones', as well as participating in discussions and sampling various products. My interest in golf comes from years of playing with friends and following professional tournaments. My love for yuri manga stems from a broader interest in Japanese culture, which I've been exploring since college.
